title: Thamate
desc: A small-time crook with a big heart is murdered for wooing the fiancee of a powerful local thug. However, he gets a second chance at life when he gets reincarnated as a politician.
Classmates Ramachandra and Janaki meet after 20 years of graduating from high school at a reunion. They start reminiscing their past days and talk about their present lives.

title: Gandana Mane
desc: Gauri, a woman from a rich family, falls in love with Raja, a man who makes ends meet as a bus conductor.

title: Sye
desc: Chakri, who dreams to become a police officer, falls for a woman named Kannika. But things change when Mosale, a corrupt policeman, provokes him to fight.

title: Ugramm
desc: Agastya, an automobile mechanic with a dangerous past, takes it upon himself to protect Nithya, a kidnapped girl, from the vengeful son of a ruthless gangster.
